newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Helix denies rights issue plans.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Helix denies rights issue plans.

text.p: Helix Resources NL said on Monday it had no plans for a A$27 million rights issue, as reported on the front page of the Australian Financial Review.

"Please be advised that the article on the front page of today's edition of the Australian Financial Review suggesting that Helix Resources NL is contemplating a A$27 million rights issue, is incorrect," the gold explorer said.
The company said it has had no discussions with any stock brokers regarding a rights issue or any other issue nor has anything been resolved at board level.
Helix raised A$13.65 million in a placement last week.
Shares in the gold explorer have soared over the past two weeks following exploration results in the Gawler Craton region of South Australia.
At 3.50 p.m. (0450 GMT), Helix shares were 11 cents down at A$3.24. The shares were trading at 45 cents two weeks ago and hit a high of A$4.15 on Thursday.
